feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样抗体所致脑容积变化主要源于淀粉样清除而非ARIA，且清除越多容积减少越显著。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗输注相关反应常见，ARIA发生率较低且认知获益早期显现。

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以可靠监测donanemab治疗后的淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916可剂量依赖性清除脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，ARIA发生率7.87%，停药主因经济负担。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型阿尔茨海默病表型患者多数不符合抗淀粉样蛋白疗法的临床试验入组标准。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可准确预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau蛋白状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促认知药试验多数疗效有限，突显AD认知改善亟需更精准靶点与设计。

mech.title: Amplification of seeding-competent tau aggregates by PMCA in human and experimental tauopathies.
mech.zh: PMCA技术可高效扩增并灵敏检测人及小鼠tau蛋白聚集体，助力tau蛋白病研究。

mech.title: Regional astrocyte dysregulation and altered glymphatic-related markers in Alzheimer's disease frontal cortex.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病额叶皮层星形胶质细胞标志物呈区域异质性失调，且类淋巴相关AQP4相对蛋白病变负荷显著降低。

mech.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
mech.zh: 抗淀粉样抗体引起的脑容积变化主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除而非ARIA。

mech.title: A Novel Nogo-A Receptor Antagonist Peptide Impedes Alzheimer's Disease Pathology by Nogo-A/NgR/ROCK Signaling Pathway.
mech.zh: 新型NgR1拮抗肽NAP2经Nogo-A/NgR/ROCK通路改善AD小鼠认知与病理。

mech.title: The UNC13A cryptic exon associates with cognitive impairment in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: UNC13A隐性外显子SNP通过削弱TDP-43结合促进异常剪接，与AD认知损害加速相关。

mech.title: Plasma Alzheimer Biomarkers and Diagnostic Decision-Making in Memory Clinics.
mech.zh: 血浆生物标志物组合在记忆门诊中显著提升病因诊断准确性与临床决策信心。

mech.title: Tau dysfunction in alzheimer's disease: molecular and cellular mechanisms, genetic modulation, and therapeutic perspectives.
mech.zh: Tau蛋白功能障碍是驱动AD神经退行及认知衰退的核心，并受遗传调控且具治疗靶向潜力。

mech.title: Proteomic signatures of protected APOE ε4 carriers reveal causal pathways associated with delayed Alzheimer's disease onset.
mech.zh: 保护性APOE ε4携带者血浆蛋白质组揭示延缓阿尔茨海默病发病的因果通路。

dx.title: Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Diagnostic Performance of Plasma p-tau217 and p-tau217/Aβ42 in Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217及其与Aβ42比值可精准预测Aβ-PET阳性，且纵向稳定性优于单独指标。

dx.title: The case for FDG-PET and NaF-PET in risk stratification of mild cognitive impairment.
dx.zh: FDG-PET与NaF-PET可补充现有模型，提升轻度认知障碍向痴呆进展的风险分层能力。

dx.title: A plasma-based protein signature combining NPTXR, ACHE, and p-tau217 predicts progression to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆NPTXR、ACHE联合p-tau217蛋白签名可显著提升无症状期向症状期阿尔茨海默病进展的预测效能。

dx.title: Tracing neuroinflammation in neurodegeneration: insights from a scoping review on biofluid biomarkers.
dx.zh: 生物体液标志物可追踪神经炎症，为多种神经退行性疾病的诊断与预后提供客观依据。

dx.title: Contribution of Myelin Content to the PET-Measured Amyloid Burden.
dx.journal: Journal of nuclear medicine : official p
dx.zh: 校正髓鞘含量可提升Aβ PET与血浆p-tau217的相关性，提示白质脱靶结合影响皮层定量。

dx.title: Plasma Alzheimer Biomarkers and Diagnostic Decision-Making in Memory Clinics.
dx.zh: 血浆生物标志物可提升记忆门诊诊断决策信心，但需结合标准检查。

dx.title: Blood Biomarkers of Alzheimer Disease and Rates of Global and Domain-Specific Cognitive Decline.
dx.zh: 血液AD生物标志物可预测老年人整体及特定认知域下降速率。

dx.title: Development and validation of an amyloid PET dementia of the Alzheimer's type (DAT) score.
dx.zh: 基于淀粉样PET的3D卷积神经网络可精准识别阿尔茨海默型痴呆，并定位关键脑区。

prev.title: Amyloid-β modulates APOE ε4 effects on cognition but not on targeted structural or functional connectivity measures over 2 years in pre-dementia adults.
prev.zh: Aβ病理调节APOE ε4对认知下降的影响，但不改变其脑结构与功能连接效应。

prev.title: Gut microbiota alterations and their correlation with constipation in older adults with Alzheimer's disease or mild cognitive impairment: A cross-sectional study.
prev.zh: AD与MCI患者肠道菌群改变与便秘显著相关，菌群差异或为共病机制。

prev.title: Histological aging signatures for monitoring tissue-specific aging and disease.
prev.zh: 组织时钟揭示器官特异性衰老速率，可预测阿尔茨海默病等慢性病风险。

prev.title: Digital clock assessment in South Asian setting: pilot study.
prev.zh: 南亚社区平板数字钟测试可行，能有效区分认知受损者。

prev.title: Toward precision neuroscience in Alzheimer's disease: the role of multimodal AI.
prev.zh: 多模态AI整合生物标志物，推动阿尔茨海默病精准分型与个体化诊疗。

prev.title: Mental health and gut-brain crosstalk: implications for depression and Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 综述揭示肠脑轴介导慢性应激，连接抑郁与阿尔茨海默病的共同病理机制。

prev.title: Age at first drink below 19 years and all-cause mortality in Chinese older adults: a 10-year prospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 中国老年人19岁前首次饮酒与10年全因死亡风险显著升高相关。

prev.title: Chronic Disease and Disability in the United States: Trends, Inequities, and Imperatives for Policy Reform.
prev.zh: 美国慢性病与寿命受制于教育不平等，普及优质教育是根本公共健康策略。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这文章讲的是，从植物里提取的天然成分，可能通过多个途径延缓老年痴呆，帮咱们普通人提前了解有啥可吃的、可防的。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 人老了脑子生病，多半和身体“生锈”有关，吃对东西也许能帮忙防一防。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 抽血查老年痴呆这事，光看准不准还不够，得先想清楚查完咋办，不然在社区医院容易白查甚至添乱。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是人体免疫系统里一个叫TREM2的“开关”，弄懂它，能帮我们更清楚怎么对付脑瘤和老年痴呆这类病。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、反应变慢，看懂它，能帮你更早留意到家里老人这些信号。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家在找能管住大脑里两种“捣乱酶”的药，好让记性差的人别忘得那么快。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，老年痴呆可能和大脑“吃不饱饭”有关，了解这点，能帮我们更早预防和延缓记性变差。

intro.title: Discovery of Anti-Neuroinflammatory Compounds in Alzheimer's Disease: Current Trends and Future Perspectives.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正尝试用消炎药来对付阿尔茨海默病，以后或许能靠它延缓病情，对家里有老人的普通人是个盼头。
